descriptionHtml:
Approach · EFS Empty & Failure States · S21 Never left waiting with nothing, both contexts: a busy state at once, then the failure message; time to the message and the 20 s attempt cap recorded

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U11 Every state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's existing style that tells the physician what to do next (retry, enable permission, sign in, check connection). (UAT EFS Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 1; TFA-94745 AC 5)
  • U12 No state ever shows a blank screen, a crash, a raw error pop-up, or invented content. (UAT EFS intro; UAT 3.4; TFA-94745 AC 2)
  • T1 Every AI call (summary, note, billing, Ask AI, photo reading, voice transcription, handoff) retries automatically before showing an error; text calls go Haiku twice, then Mistral; … (TFA-94745 AC 4; TFA-92568 AC 5; UAT 3.5)

Test design technique: Performance (performance) — Measure the time and check it is within the required seconds.

Given Standard fixture; the harness makes the model hang past its attempt timeout for Ask AI and for the pre-round summary (both models)

When In Hospital and in Nursing Home: ask an Ask AI question, and press Save Note on a typed pre-round, with both models hanging; snapshot right after each tap and when the screen settles. Then, in Nursing Home, Generate a long note with Haiku failing at once and Mistral answering at 19 s (run c) and at 21 s (run d)

Then Right after each tap the step's busy label is visible; the screen ends on an explicit failure message with a next step, never a spinner still running after 60 s. The tap-to-message time and the AI call's own time (providerMs vs durationMs) are recorded; anything over 30 s is flagged for review with Vikram (3.5), not judged. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Pass/Fail only on 'never left with nothing': each busy checkpoint mustContain the step's own loading label ('Searching' for Ask AI, 'Saving & Updating' for Save Note; a placeholder or a disabled button no longer counts), each settled checkpoint mustNotContain it and has a failure word and a next-step phrase (separate groups). …

Where it ran: dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S21 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/EFS.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: dev.
